## Purpose

Describe the user-visible outcome and why the change is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] `bash scripts/check_site.sh` passes locally.
- [ ] Generated music pages were rebuilt after any catalog, lyric, or release-metadata edit.
- [ ] New or changed pages were checked at narrow and wide viewport widths.
- [ ] New images include meaningful alt text (or an intentional empty alt), intrinsic dimensions, and responsive optimized sources where appropriate.
- [ ] Metadata, canonical URLs, structured data, internal links, and sitemap entries reflect the final public URL.
- [ ] No credentials, private analytics data, build output, or editor files are included.

## Evidence

Add screenshots, accessibility notes, performance measurements, or other review evidence when the change affects rendering or interaction.
